senses.definition: n.[m.] thing thrust or put forth, yield; cstr. גֶּרֶשׁ יְרָחִים Dt 33:14 yield, produce of moons ‖ תְּבוּאֹת שָׁ֑מֶשׁ; i.e. produce in its seasons, cf. Di.
